messages.content:
You explain movements in software telemetry by attributing them to a commit.

THE NUMBERS ARE ALREADY COMPUTED AND ARE NOT YOURS TO RECOMPUTE.
The finding was produced by a deterministic detector. Treat its numbers as fact. Your
job is judgement, not arithmetic: given that this movement happened, which commit in
the window explains it, and what is the evidence?

Method:
- Start with list_commits_in_window. You get subjects and file-change counts.
- Use describe_commit on the few that plausibly relate. Look at which files changed.
- Use sample_telemetry_rows only if you need to see the shape of the raw data.
- Then call submit_answer. You MUST finish by calling submit_answer.

REFUSAL IS A CORRECT ANSWER AND IS EXPECTED SOMETIMES.
There is always a commit in a window. That does not mean one of them caused the
movement. If no commit plausibly explains it, call submit_answer with refused=true and
commits=[]. A confident wrong attribution is worse than an honest refusal, because it
will be believed. Check dates: a commit after the movement cannot have caused it.

Name at most 3 commits.

FINDING field_appearance:reasoningTokens
  metric : telemetry field `reasoningTokens`
  movement: absent from every row before 2026-07-03, then present on 190 rows on 2026-07-03 itself (190 of them non-zero). The field did not start being non-zero — it started EXISTING.
  window : 2026-06-26 .. 2026-07-03

6 commits are in this window. Attribute the movement, or refuse.

function.arguments: {"commits":["7b99e09"], "refused":false, "rationale":"Reasoning: The jump is best explained by the 2026-06-22 commit 7b99e09 (\"feat(telemetry): cost-instrument ASR/detect/enrichment + fix cost overestimate\"). Evidence: this commit edits electron/agent/telemetry.ts (the repository file that emits agent telemetry) plus several files involved in ASR/enrichment and LLM token accounting (electron/agent/asr/*, electron/memory/llm.ts, electron/memory/resolveEnrichmentModel.ts, providers/pricing.ts). The commit subject explicitly says it cost-instruments ASR/detect/enrichment — introducing a new numeric telemetry field like reasoningTokens (an enrichment/LLM token count) fits that intent. Other commits in the window that touch telemetry are less likely: 03d07b1 (2026-06-21) only adds structural live_asr_window telemetry (ASR window structural events) and the bake-off harness (fc44797, 5770708) changes test/harness telemetry, not production agent token accounting; d05fad4 is server-side JIRA/sdk telemetry. Timing: 7b99e09 predates the observed appearance (2026-07-03), consistent with a code change deployed/turned on later that day. Therefore attribute the appearance of reasoningTokens to 7b99e09."}
